Daily Devotional

April 9

16 Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified. (Galatians 2:16 KJV)

Notice that we are justified by the faith OF Jesus Christ, not faith IN Jesus. We do need faith in Jesus, but our justification is not from our faith, but is the faith of Jesus that justifies us, as we receive His faith in the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23) upon salvation. The works of the law is referring to any work that we do to try to justify ourselves to God. Religion has been teaching most of the time, that you are saved by faith in Jesus, but then you must do works of the law before God will bless you or use you (like tithing, going to church, etc.). That is just not so, as this verse is saying that no flesh can be justified by works of the law. That doesn’t mean you shouldn’t do anything for the Lord, but you should want to do things for the Lord out of love for Him, and not out of necessity (1 Thessalonians 1:3). You cannot mix Grace and Works for your salvation (Romans 11:6), and the true Gospel is salvation by Grace through faith (Ephesians 2:8) in Jesus only.

Christians who do get saved by faith in Jesus, and then do fall back into trying to do the works of the law to be right with God, are liable to fall out of being saved by Grace. Thereby losing the salvation that Jesus has provided through His Grace (Romans 9:32). Praise God for our salvation and bringing us back into relationship with the Father (John 17:3) – Thank you Lord.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
